text:
Asking rents in Rhein-Erft district stand at a median of 11.98 €/m² (2026-06), up 3.0% on the year and +23.5% over five years. That ranks Rhein-Erft district #17 of 37 cities; new lets are priced 56% above the 2022 average contract rent of 7.67 €/m².

A 60 m² flat costs about 719 € a month in cold rent, 15.3% of the disposable income of two residents. Listings stay online for about 25 days and 26% are gone within a week; with 1.2% market-active vacancy and +2.3% population growth over five years, the market looks tight.

The model estimate for twelve months ahead is 12.77 €/m² (+6.6%), with an 80% range of 12.41 to 13.13 €/m²; housing-loan rates are at 4.01%.
